next.reason: 1985: "If the number of character positions in the record that is read is less than the minimum size specified by the record description entries"; 2023: "For a record sequential file, if the number of bytes in the record that is read is less than the minimum size specified". The 2023 undefined-remainder and truncation rule is limited to record sequential files. For indexed files only I-O status 04 (9.1.13.2) still covers a length conflict.
